counting_rule: One group per ordered cache-source checkpoint and target checkpoint pair; multiple evaluation windows are evidence within that group, never additional groups.
relative_loss_definition: 100 * (Rebuild - Reuse) / Rebuild; positive means Reuse is lower.

groups.label: retained_original_positive_baseline
groups.publication_relation: Original adjacent daily model releases; cache source is the actual immediate training parent.
groups.cache_relation: At each request, old and new models encode exactly the same complete causal history prefix capped at 1024. Rebuild reads target-model KV with target parameters; Reuse reads cache-source-model KV with target parameters.
groups.reliability: Positive NDCG@10 difference with nominal user-level 95% interval entirely above zero; Recall@10 also positive.
reliability_limits: Selected from nine evaluated adjacent pairs after seeing their results; this is retained development evidence, not an independent confirmation set.
The 95% interval is a paired user-cluster bootstrap for request-macro NDCG@10; nominal per-pair coverage, no multiple-comparison correction.
Same fixed training-user cohort evaluated strictly after the target model cutoff; shared users/checkpoints make groups statistically dependent.
Matched causal-prefix snapshots, not persistent-cache/FIFO serving; prior observed test feedback may enter subsequent histories causally.
Observed-positive relevance over complete logged candidate sets; unexposed candidates are unknown, not observed negative feedback.
Only one complete future-day window is currently recorded per group; stability across additional windows is not established.

groups.label: replicated_release_interval_positive
groups.publication_relation: Recorded daily optimizer path retained; intermediate checkpoints are treated as unpublished, and the target is released after its final training cutoff.
groups.cache_relation: At every request both models encode the identical causal prefix capped at 1024. Target reads its own KV for Rebuild and the designated ancestor KV for Reuse.
groups.reliability: Both pilot and disjoint-user replication have Rebuild > Reuse. Replication nominal 95% interval is entirely above zero.
reliability_limits: Primary reported numbers use replication users only; pilot metrics are separate development evidence, never pooled to strengthen the result.

Pilot and replication chosen UID lists are disjoint, including inactive users; the same target models and calendar day are shared, so this is not an independent training seed or time-window replication.
Pair was selected during exploration; nominal user-cluster bootstrap intervals are not multiple-comparison-adjusted.
Both samples come from the original fixed training-user cohort with strictly future requests; this is not unseen-user generalization.
Complete logged candidates and matched causal history prefixes capped at 1024; this is not persistent-cache/FIFO serving.
Only the recorded complete natural-day windows are established; no additional-window stability is assumed.

failed_extraepoch_evidence.status: All four training/evaluation runs completed, but none supplied a new positive pair; failed refers to the scientific objective, not execution.
